purpose: Accuracy of rodas5p_core::dense_phi_action (k=0..4) and matrix_exp_pade13 vs mpmath 30-digit references (augmented-matrix expm) on 8x8/64x64 random dense, nonnormal upper-triangular, stiff diagonal, ||A||_1 in {1e-3,1,1e3}, ||v||_2 in {1e-8,1,1e8}; plus Rust-only proportionality probe phi(A, s v) vs s*phi(A, v).
commands: python3 reference.py > reference_stdout.txt 2> reference_stderr.txt  (this session; 242 s)
hypothesis_verdicts: dense_phi_action is NOT scale-invariant in v: for every one of the 18 cases with ||v||=1e8 (all three matrix types, all ||A||, n=8 and 64), phi_k(A)v for k=1..4 has relative error 2.7e-9..1.6e-8 (threshold 2.2e-13), while k=0 (uses matrix_exp_pade13 directly) and matrix_exp_pade13 itself stay at 1e-16..3.5e-14. The Rust-only probe confirms phi_k(A,1e8 v) deviates from 1e8*phi_k(A,v) by the same ~1e-8 (and by <=1e-15 for 1e-8 v), so the mpmath reference is not the cause.

Mechanism (code read): crates/rodas5p-core/src/matrix_functions.rs dense_phi_action embeds the unscaled v in the augmented [[A, v, 0..],[0, J]] matrix and calls matrix_exp_pade13, whose squaring count is chosen from the 1-norm of the *augmented* matrix (matrix_functions.rs:80-86); ||v||=1e8 forces ~24 extra squarings, amplifying rounding to ~1e-8. Standard remedy (Al-Mohy & Higham 2011 / KIOPS) is to scale the augmentation column by 1/||v|| (or eta) and undo it on output.
||v||=1 and ||v||=1e-8: PASS for all k (worst 2.44e-14 at ||A||=1e3, within 1e3*eps).
notes: expm_lastcol_relerr=1.0 for the stiff-diagonal ||A||=1e3 cases is exp(-1000)=5e-435 underflowing to 0 in f64 - not a defect.

Impact to be confirmed by the verification phase: which production paths call dense_phi_action / dense_fused_phi_action with vectors far from unit norm (the fused Krylov oracle passes projected vectors; counters phi_dense_oracle_calls). At integrator tolerances 1e-6..1e-8 a 1e-8 relative phi error is at the tolerance level.
Reference: one augmented (n+4)x(n+4) mpmath expm at 30 digits per case; consistency between augmented and direct expm(A)v references is exact to 30 digits (aug_vs_direct = 0).
